entities.summary: Ibad Movsum oghlu Huseynov is an Azerbaijani military man, scout, National Hero of Azerbaijan, and commander of the reconnaissance-sabotage group. In 1990–1994 he took part in the first Karabakh War. Intelligence Commander Ibad Huseynov spoke about one of his historical operations in the village of Muganli.
